A little about us

More than a ride.
A part of your story.

Sri Thirumalai Deivam Transport helps families, friends, schools and organisations travel together from Pappireddipatti, Alamelupuram, Kolimekkenur and surrounding areas. Whether it is a sacred temple visit, a wedding celebration or a long-awaited getaway, we make it easier to bring everyone along.

Tell us where you want to go, when you plan to travel and what your group needs. We’ll help you enquire about a suitable bus for your journey.
